name: Llama 3.2 3B
description: Small and quick. Good for short questions, rewording and simple summaries.

name: Phi-4 Mini
description: A compact model that reasons well for its size. Good for quick answers on modest hardware.

name: Gemma 3 4B
description: A small general model with a friendly writing style. Good for drafting and everyday chat.

name: Mistral 7B
description: A dependable all-rounder for chat, summaries and short documents.

name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B
description: Tuned for programming. Good for explaining, writing and fixing code.

name: Llama 3.1 8B
description: A well-rounded everyday assistant that can also use tools, so it suits simple agents.

name: DeepSeek R1 8B
description: Thinks step by step before answering. Good for problems that need working out.

name: Gemma 3 12B
description: A stronger writer than the small models. Good for longer drafts and careful rewording.

name: Qwen 2.5 14B
description: A capable general model for documents, analysis and tool use.

name: Phi-4 14B
description: Careful and precise. Good for analysis, structured answers and checking work.

name: DeepSeek R1 14B
description: Step-by-step reasoning with more depth than the 8B version.

name: GPT-OSS 20B
description: A strong general model that reasons and uses tools. Only part of it is active at a time, so it runs on less graphics memory than its size suggests.

name: Gemma 3 27B
description: The largest Gemma. Good for long-form writing and detailed answers on a large graphics card.

name: Qwen 3 30B
description: A large general model that thinks before answering and uses tools. Only part of it is active at a time, so system memory can carry most of it.

name: Qwen 3 Coder 30B
description: A large programming model for bigger coding tasks and agents. Only part of it is active at a time, so system memory can carry most of it.

name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B
description: A top programming model for a 24 GB graphics card.

name: Llama 3.3 70B
description: A very large general model for workstations with a lot of graphics memory.
